# ADR-0002: Drizzle ORM instead of Prisma

**Status:** accepted · **Date:** 2026-09-26

**Context.** The brief suggested Prisma. Prisma needs native engine binaries downloaded at install
time; the build environment's network policy blocked that host, so migrations and queries could not
be verified. Unverified persistence would violate the "run the real commands" requirement.

**Decision.** Use Drizzle ORM (pure TypeScript, `pg` driver) with SQL migrations generated by
drizzle-kit and committed, plus hand-written SQL migrations for triggers. pgvector is supported
natively for the RAG phase.

**Consequences.** Migrations are plain SQL that reviewers can read. Transactions, row locks
(`FOR UPDATE`) and conditional updates are explicit. Switching to Prisma later would mean
re-expressing the schema; the service layer would be unaffected in shape.
